Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Nikhil Saxena. I am a 30-year-old cardiologist living in Mysuru. Varun Patil has filed a police complaint against me over INR 45,80,000/-, and the complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 62582 42865 or email nikhil.saxena76@example.in.
